credential_pegged.quote: Obtain certification from NARM and currently hold the title of CPM

required.quote: In order to receive certification as a CPM-TN, an applicant shall: (1) Obtain certification from NARM and currently hold the title of CPM

experience_source.quote: Obtain certification from NARM and currently hold the title of CPM

interval_years.quote: The certificate is renewable pursuant to the division of health related boards' biennial birthdates renewal system.

required.quote: Renewal is available to the CPM who maintains current certification from NARM by complying with the continuing education requirement applicable to the CPM.

exists.quote: There is hereby established a council of certified professional midwifery, which shall serve as a subcommittee of and report to the board.

name.quote: "Council" means the council of certified professional midwifery

authority.value: Assist and advise the board and the department in developing rules; make recommendations to the board and the department regarding certified professional midwifery, applications and renewals, and related matters; any action on certification shall be made by the council, subject to approval by the board.
authority.quote: Any action on the certification shall be made by the council, subject to approval by the board.

national_certification.quote: "Certified professional midwife (CPM)" means a person who has obtained national certification from the North American Registry of Midwives

national_association.quote: Assist and advise the board and the department in developing rules with guidance from the Midwives Alliance of North America's Core Competencies

regulatory_model.quote: a certificate under this chapter is required to practice midwifery for monetary compensation in which service has been offered for a fee

credential_type.quote: A midwife who has met the standards set forth in this chapter may apply to the board for Tennessee certification.

is_mandatory.quote: a certificate under this chapter is required to practice midwifery for monetary compensation in which service has been offered for a fee

title_protection.quote: A midwife who is certified under the standard found in § 63-29-108 may use the initials "CPM-TN."

scope_protection.quote: a certificate under this chapter is required to practice midwifery for monetary compensation in which service has been offered for a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a certificate to practice midwifery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a certificate to practice midwifery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to alcohol or drugs to the degree of interfering with midwifery duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to alcohol or drugs to the degree of interfering with midwifery duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate any provision of this chapter or any lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of, or conspired to violate, any provision of this chapter or any lawful order of the board issued pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: the practice of attending low-risk women during pregnancy, labor and the post-birth period with the informed consent of the mother. The scope of midwifery shall include comprehensive care of the pregnant woman during the antepartal phase, intrapartal phase, and postpartal phase, and application of emergency care when necessary

The scope of midwifery shall include comprehensive care of the pregnant woman during the antepartal phase, intrapartal phase, and postpartal phase, and application of emergency care when necessary

value: routine antepartal and postpartal laboratory analysis (screening only)
methods_authorized.quote: The scope of midwifery shall include comprehensive care of the pregnant woman during the antepartal phase, intrapartal phase, and postpartal phase, and application of emergency care when necessary

drug_authority.value: The allowable scope includes administration of medication as prescribed by a physician; no independent prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: allowable scope of midwifery practice regarding use of equipment, procedures, and administration of medication as prescribed by a physician

national_credential_required.quote: "CPM-TN" means certified professional midwife in Tennessee. A "CPM-TN" must be certified to practice midwifery by the North American Registry of Midwives

cpr_certification_required.quote: Have proof of current CPR certification including infant or neonatal resuscitation.

neonatal_resuscitation_certification_req.quote: Have proof of current CPR certification including infant or neonatal resuscitation.

collaborative_agreement_required.quote: The CPM-TN shall form a collaborative care plan with a physician for all clients.

collaborative_agreement_details.value: The CPM-TN must form a collaborative care plan with a physician for all clients; the emergency plan must include documentation of initial consultation with the physician; referral and transfer plans must be included; a copy shall be sent to named physicians.
collaborative_agreement_details.quote: The CPM-TN shall develop an emergency plan that shall be signed by the client and placed in the client chart at the initial visit. The emergency plan shall include documentation of the initial consultation with the physician previously referenced in subsection (a). The documentation shall also include referral and transfer plans for the patient in the event of an emergency. A copy of the plan shall be sent to the named physicians.

prescription_authority_prohibited.quote: allowable scope of midwifery practice regarding use of equipment, procedures, and administration of medication as prescribed by a physician

consultation_referral_trigger_conditions.quote: Abnormal findings would require a consultation with a physician.

emergency_transfer_plan_required.quote: The CPM-TN shall develop an emergency plan that shall be signed by the client and placed in the client chart at the initial visit.

hospital_transfer_protocol_requirements.value: Emergency plan must include documentation of initial physician consultation and referral and transfer plans; a copy of the plan must be sent to the named physicians.
hospital_transfer_protocol_requirements.quote: The documentation shall also include referral and transfer plans for the patient in the event of an emergency. A copy of the plan shall be sent to the named physicians.

permitted_birth_settings.quote: The CPM-TN may provide care for the low-risk client who is expected to have a normal pregnancy, labor, birth and postpartal phase in the setting of the mother's choice.

informed_consent_required_content.quote: The CPM-TN shall ensure that the client has signed an informed consent form. This form shall include information to inform the client of the qualifications of the CPM-TN.

outcome_data_reporting_required.quote: Compilation of annual statistics on CPM-TN deliveries

birth_certificate_filing_required.quote: The CPM-TN shall maintain a birth certificate for each birth in accordance with the requirements of title 68. A copy of the birth certificate shall be filed with the department.

newborn_screening_obligations.quote: The CPM-TN shall instruct the parents regarding the requirements of § 68-5-202. The CPM-TN shall instruct the parents regarding the requirement of § 68-5-401.

advisory_council_composition.value: Three certified professional midwives, one consumer with no direct or indirect affiliation with the midwifery profession or industry, one certified nurse midwife, and one physician; all appointed by the commissioner of health.
advisory_council_composition.quote: The council shall consist of six (6) members... Members shall consist of three (3) certified professional midwives, one (1) consumer who has no direct or indirect affiliation with the midwifery profession or industry, one (1) certified nurse midwife, and one (1) physician.
